name: Chair Sit-to-Stand

instructions.description: Sit near the front of a stable chair with your feet shoulder width-apart, planted flat.
Lean the trunk slightly forward and press through both feet.
Stand fully without using momentum; use the armrests if required.
Reach the hips back and lower under control to sit.

commentsNotes: Suitable for many beginners and older adults when the chair is stable.

variations.variationDescription: Chair Sit-to-Stand — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Chair Sit-to-Stand — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
